page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn7i-2x.8xlarge is a GPU-accelerated virtual machine instance within the Compute Optimized with GPU family. Built on the KVM hypervisor and x86_64 architecture, this instance is configured with 32 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at a base clock speed of 2.9 GHz. System memory totals 128.0 GB, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB RAM per vCPU.

Hardware acceleration is supplied by two NVIDIA A10 GPUs offering a combined total of 48 GB VRAM, with 24 GB of memory per GPU. The instance does not include local storage, requiring network-attached cloud storage solutions for persistent data. Networking infrastructure provides a baseline network bandwidth of 16 Gbps, while zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses are assigned by default.

From an efficiency perspective, the integration of dual NVIDIA A10 accelerators with 32 dedicated compute cores and 128 GB of RAM enables balanced distribution of graphics and machine learning inference pipelines across multiple processing units. Because no local storage is bundled, system configurations must account for external block storage bandwidth alongside network operations. The ecs.gn7i-2x.8xlarge instance is suited for AI model inference, parallel deep learning tasks, video rendering, cloud graphics workstations, and medium-scale scientific simulations.
